brief: Scan FULL cambie_depth3_check (level-1 short-circuit OR level-2 depth-3 fallback) for ALL primes p ≡ 7 mod 8 in range 1000000000 < p ≤ 10000000000 (the (10^9, 10^10] range — approximately 100 million primes). rounds.claimText: For the residue class p ≡ 7 mod 8 in the range 1000000000 < p ≤ 10000000000 (approximately 100 million primes), the FULL cambie_depth3_check (level-1 short-circuit OR level-2 depth-3 fallback) holds with zero axiom failures and minimum c3/(4p^3) ratio expected to exceed 1.20 (matching the axiom comment growth law from UnconditionalClosure.lean line 530 and confirmed at (10^8, 10^9] in R5' with min 1.21066), testable in PARI as: default(realprecision,30); R3MIN=100.0; P3MIN=0; AXFAILS=0; L1FAILS=0; CT=0; start_wall=getwalltime(); forprime(p=1000000001,10000000000,if(p%8==7,CT=CT+1;N=(3*p-1)/4;phi_N=eulerphi(N);c2=3*p^2-p+2*(p-1)*phi_N;r1=c2*1.0/(4*p^2);if(r1<0.9849,L1FAILS=L1FAILS+1;c3=p*c2+(p-1)*eulerphi(c2);r2=c3*1.0/(4*p^3);if(r2<1.0,AXFAILS=AXFAILS+1;print("AXIOM_FAIL p=",p," r1=",r1," r2=",r2));if(r2<R3MIN,R3MIN=r2;P3MIN=p)))); print("CT=",CT," L1FAILS=",L1FAILS," AXFAILS=",AXFAILS," P3MIN=",P3MIN," R3MIN=",R3MIN," margin=",R3MIN-1.0," elapsed_s=",(getwalltime()-start_wall)/1000); quit.
